claims.text: To Tradition mages, Las Vegas shows the Technocracy as a power of control more than of science, from the secrets kept at Area 51 to the cameras watching every casino table.
Yet the city's lights and spectacle still open the imagination, and mages roused by the Rogue Council see a chance to gamble on a great stake.
The city was formally founded in 1905, and federal interest in the area began with surveys ahead of the Hoover Dam.

title: Hoover Dam
summary: An Etherite triumph the Union claimed.

claims.text: Sons of Ether, with the Utopians loudest among them, put their designs and building methods to work on the dam.
It rose while the Technocracy was busy brushing Etherite discoveries off as pulp fiction, so its success stung the Inner Circle; the Union later took it over.
Power lines ran some 200 miles from California, and a whole town, Boulder City, was built for about 5,000 workers and their families before work began.

title: The Black Pyramid Chantry
summary: The mixed Tradition Chantry under the Luxor.

claims.text: The Luxor's pyramid is a weak Node, and a loose group of Tradition mages holds mystic sway over it with wards against the Technocracy.
Their Chantry meets in the Sun Chamber beneath the hotel under the Hermetic Malcolm Henry, who tries more to build agreement than to rule.
Visiting mages may use its ritual rooms for news or Tass, but only with references and after a watched waiting period.

title: Area 51
summary: The secret test site near Nellis Air Force Base.

claims.text: A Technocratic commission works from hidden corners of Nellis Air Force Base, drawing on a strong Node and laboratory, and even the base's commanding general knows little of its work.
Some say the Union studies captured alien hardware there; others say the stories only mask human-made secret projects.
